item.title: Machine Learning
item.description: Machine learning is a field of artificial intelligence focused on algorithms that learn patterns from data and improve their performance on tasks without being explicitly programmed.
item.author: tech.editors@wikipedia.org (Wikipedia Technology Contributors)

item.title: CRISPR Gene Editing
item.description: CRISPR gene editing is a genetic engineering technique that uses the Cas9 enzyme and guide RNA to precisely cut and modify DNA sequences within living organisms.
item.author: biology.editors@wikipedia.org (Wikipedia Biology Contributors)

item.title: Fusion Power Fusion
item.description: Fusion power produces electricity from the heat released when light atomic nuclei, such as hydrogen isotopes, fuse together.
item.author: energy.editors@wikipedia.org (Wikipedia Energy Contributors)

item.title: Blockchain
item.description: A blockchain is a distributed ledger of records, called blocks, that are securely linked together using cryptographic hashes, making the stored data resistant to tampering.
item.author: tech.editors@wikipedia.org (Wikipedia Technology Contributors)
